description: TI DRV8434S stepper motor driver, SPI, integrated current sense, 1/256 microstepping, 4.5-48 V, 2.5 A full-scale, HTSSOP-28 PowerPAD

pinout.name: VCP
pinout.notes: charge pump output; 0.22 uF 16 V X7R to VM

pinout.name: DVDD
pinout.notes: internal logic regulator output; 0.47-1 uF X7R to GND

pinout.name: nFAULT
pinout.notes: fault indication, open drain, needs external pull-up

pinout.name: VREF
pinout.notes: current set reference input, max 3.3 V operating

pinout.name: nSCS
pinout.notes: SPI chip select, active low, internal pull-up to DVDD

pinout.name: SDO
pinout.notes: SPI data out, push-pull, swings between GND and VSDO (p.3 5.1 pin functions: 'VSDO ... 适用于 SDO 输出的电源引脚'; p.6 6.5 electrical characteristics: 'RPU，SDO 内部上拉电阻 5mA 负载，以 VSDO 为基准')

pinout.name: ENABLE
pinout.notes: output enable, internal pull-up to DVDD

pinout.name: nSLEEP
pinout.notes: sleep input, internal pull-down; low pulse clears faults

pinout.name: CPL
pinout.notes: charge pump switch node; 0.022 uF X7R rated VM between CPH and CPL

abs_max.param: Control pin voltage (STEP, DIR, ENABLE, nFAULT, SDI, SDO, SCLK, nSCS)
Continuous phase node pin voltage (AOUT1, AOUT2, BOUT1, BOUT2)
Transient 100 ns phase node pin voltage (AOUT1, AOUT2, BOUT1, BOUT2)
